video_title: Black Flag Has Been Remastered And It's So Good
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies CUKTECH sponsoring NoodleNick's August 3, 2026 English-language YouTube video. SponsorRadar tracks 71 CUKTECH sponsorships across 61 channels, with 25% of recent deals going to channels in the 50K-250K range, including UltimateiDeviceVids (~129K) and Benidorm Enthusiast (~80K), showing practical small/mid-size creator fit. CUKTECH sells tangible consumer charging hardware such as power banks and chargers. Its official marketing collaboration page publishes mkt@cuktech.com specifically for collaborations with media, advertising agencies, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
